server_name.description: Public FTP server name shown to clients.

server_type.description: Run mode: standalone daemon, or launched per-connection by inetd.

default_server.description: Handle connections not matched by a <VirtualHost>.

umask.description: Default umask for newly created files/directories.

max_instances.description: Maximum number of child server processes.

max_clients_per_host.description: Maximum simultaneous clients from one host (0 = unlimited).

run_user.description: System user the daemon drops privileges to.

run_group.description: System group the daemon drops privileges to.

default_root.description: Chroot each login to this directory ('~' = the user's home; empty = no chroot).

require_valid_shell.description: Require the login user to have a shell in /etc/shells (off for virtual/FTP-only users).

allow_overwrite.description: Allow clients to overwrite existing files.

timeout_idle.description: Idle session timeout in seconds (0 = no limit).

passive_ports.description: Passive-mode port range "min max" (open this range in the firewall).

ident_lookups.description: Perform RFC1413 ident lookups on connecting clients (slow; usually off).

use_reverse_dns.description: Reverse-resolve client IPs in logs (slow; usually off).
